title: scrollgrid1D~
description: `scrollgrid1D~` is a stabilized scroll-grid chaotic oscillator implemented as a switched unstable linear system, with three signal outputs corresponding to X, Y, and Z. Its parameters include spiral frequency in Hz, unstable “attack” and stable “release” time constants in milliseconds, and N, the number of scrolls or unstable rotation centers; its first inlet also accepts a `reset` message.
